```{r load, filter, annotate}
#fix naming
recognizer <- recognizer %>%
  mutate(qseqid = str_replace(qseqid, "_#.*$", "")) %>%
  rename(
    db_id                       = `DB ID`,
    protein_description         = `Protein description`,
    db_description              = `DB description`,
    general_functional_category = `General functional category`,
    functional_category         = `Functional category`
  ) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_to_lower(.) %>% str_replace_all("\\s+", "_")) %>%
  select(
    qseqid,
    db_id,
    protein_description,
    db_description,
    general_functional_category,
    functional_category
  )


#load files
read_gene_score_file <- function(f, suffix_regex) {
  df <- readr::read_tsv(
    f,
    col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
    na = c("", "NA", "NaN", "nan", "NULL")
  )
  
  if (!("gene_id" %in% names(df))) {
    stop("No gene_id column in file: ", f)
  }
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(across(
      .cols = -gene_id,
      .fns  = ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))
    ))
  
  mag <- stringr::str_remove(basename(f), suffix_regex)
  mutate(df, MAG_ID = mag)
}

load_gene_dir <- function(dir, file_pattern = "\\.tsv$", suffix_regex) {
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = file_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(files)) stop("No files found in: ", dir)
  
  bind_rows(lapply(files, read_gene_score_file, suffix_regex = suffix_regex)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_id))
}
```

```{r hypergeometric test }

perform_hypergeo_binary <- function(
    annot_tbl, gene_flags_tbl, category_col, exclude_mobilome = FALSE
) {
  stopifnot(is.character(category_col), length(category_col) == 1)
  if (!("qseqid" %in% names(annot_tbl))) stop("annot_tbl needs 'qseqid'")
  if (!("MAG_ID" %in% names(annot_tbl))) stop("annot_tbl needs 'MAG_ID'")
  if (!(category_col %in% names(annot_tbl)))
    stop(sprintf("annot_tbl needs '%s'", category_col))
  if (!all(c("qseqid", "has_sig_site") %in% names(gene_flags_tbl)))
    stop("gene_flags_tbl needs 'qseqid' and 'has_sig_site'")
  
  annot_use <- annot_tbl
  if (exclude_mobilome && "functional_category" %in% names(annot_use)) {
    annot_use <- annot_use %>%
      filter(is.na(functional_category) |
               functional_category != "Mobilome: prophages, transposons")
  }
  

  pairs <- annot_use[, c("qseqid", "MAG_ID", category_col)]
  names(pairs) <- c("qseqid", "MAG_ID", "cat")
  pairs <- pairs[!is.na(pairs$cat), , drop = FALSE]
  pairs <- unique(pairs)
  
  pairs_flag <- left_join(
    tibble::as_tibble(pairs), tibble::as_tibble(gene_flags_tbl), by = "qseqid"
  )
  
  N <- n_distinct(pairs_flag$qseqid)
  M <- n_distinct(pairs_flag$qseqid[pairs_flag$has_sig_site])
  
  if (N == 0L) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      category_col = character(), category = character(),
      total_count = integer(), significant_count = integer(),
      n_mags_total = integer(), n_mags_significant = integer(),
      N = integer(), M = integer(),
      hypergeo_p = double(), hypergeo_p_adj = double()
    ))
  }
  
  pairs_flag %>%
    group_by(cat) %>%
    summarise(
      total_count        = n_distinct(qseqid),
      significant_count  = n_distinct(qseqid[has_sig_site]),
      # DISTINCT MAGs contributing >=1 gene to this category, any significance
      n_mags_total       = n_distinct(MAG_ID),
      # DISTINCT MAGs contributing >=1 SIGNIFICANT gene in this category
      n_mags_significant = n_distinct(MAG_ID[has_sig_site]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      N = N, M = M,
      hypergeo_p = stats::phyper(
        q = significant_count - 1, m = M, n = N - M,
        k = total_count, lower.tail = FALSE
      ),
      hypergeo_p_adj = stats::p.adjust(hypergeo_p, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    arrange(hypergeo_p_adj) %>%
    rename(category = cat) %>%
    mutate(category_col = category_col, .before = 1) %>%
    select(category_col, category, total_count, significant_count,
           n_mags_total, n_mags_significant, N, M, hypergeo_p, hypergeo_p_adj)
}

bh_category_fields <- c(
  "functional_category", "general_functional_category", "protein_description"
)

run_bh_binary <- function(gene_flags_tbl, exclude_mobilome) {
  bind_rows(lapply(bh_category_fields, function(cat_col) {
    perform_hypergeo_binary(
      annot_tbl        = annotations_universe,
      gene_flags_tbl   = gene_flags_tbl,
      category_col     = cat_col,
      exclude_mobilome = exclude_mobilome
    )
  }))
}

make_gene_flags <- function(sig_tbl, which_test, universe_tbl) {
  sig_ids <- sig_tbl %>%
    filter(test == which_test) %>%
    distinct(gene_id) %>%
    rename(qseqid = gene_id)
  
  universe_tbl %>%
    distinct(qseqid) %>%
    left_join(mutate(sig_ids, has_sig_site = TRUE), by = "qseqid") %>%
    mutate(has_sig_site = !is.na(has_sig_site)) %>%
    select(qseqid, has_sig_site)
}

#guard to ensure that the annotations_universe has a MAG_ID
stopifnot("MAG_ID" %in% names(annotations_universe))

#per-test flags and runs
gene_flags_paired  <- make_gene_flags(min_bh_sig, "paired_tTest",  annotations_universe)
gene_flags_fat     <- make_gene_flags(min_bh_sig, "fat_tTest",     annotations_universe)
gene_flags_control <- make_gene_flags(min_bh_sig, "control_tTest", annotations_universe)

hg_bh_paired      <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_paired,  exclude_mobilome = FALSE)
hg_bh_paired_nom  <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_paired,  exclude_mobilome = TRUE)
hg_bh_fat         <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_fat,     exclude_mobilome = FALSE)
hg_bh_fat_nom     <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_fat,     exclude_mobilome = TRUE)
hg_bh_control     <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_control, exclude_mobilome = FALSE)
hg_bh_control_nom <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_control, exclude_mobilome = TRUE)

#combo flag (fat & paired & !control) and runs
gene_flags_combo <- gene_flags_fat %>%
  rename(sig_fat = has_sig_site) %>%
  left_join(gene_flags_paired  %>% rename(sig_paired  = has_sig_site), by = "qseqid") %>%
  left_join(gene_flags_control %>% rename(sig_control = has_sig_site), by = "qseqid") %>%
  mutate(
    sig_fat     = coalesce(sig_fat,     FALSE),
    sig_paired  = coalesce(sig_paired,  FALSE),
    sig_control = coalesce(sig_control, FALSE),
    has_sig_site = sig_fat & sig_paired & !sig_control
  ) %>%
  select(qseqid, has_sig_site)

message("Combo sig genes: ", sum(gene_flags_combo$has_sig_site),
        " / universe genes: ", nrow(gene_flags_combo))


hg_bh_combo_nom <- run_bh_binary(gene_flags_combo, exclude_mobilome = TRUE)
```

```{r results files}
write_results <- function(hg_tbl, filename) {
  out <- hg_tbl %>% arrange(category_col, hypergeo_p_adj)
  write_tsv(out, file.path(out_dir, filename))
```

```{r q-value plots -- combo}

SIG_CUTOFF <- 0.05

prep_panel <- function(hg_tbl, field, sig_cutoff = SIG_CUTOFF) {
  hg_tbl %>%
    filter(category_col == field, hypergeo_p_adj < sig_cutoff) %>%
    mutate(
      nlog10_q = -log10(pmax(hypergeo_p_adj, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      category = forcats::fct_reorder(category, significant_count)
    )
}

make_enrich_plot <- function(df_plot, y_label, sig_cutoff = SIG_CUTOFF) {
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = nlog10_q, y = category)) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = -log10(sig_cutoff),
      linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 2.2, stroke = 0.7) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      name   = expression(-log[10](italic(q))),
      limits = c(0, NA),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))
    ) +
    labs(y = y_label) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      panel.grid   = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.ticks   = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3)
    )
}

qval_plots <- list()

for (fld in bh_category_fields) {
  df_fld <- prep_panel(hg_bh_combo_nom, fld)
  qval_plots[[fld]] <- make_enrich_plot(df_fld, fld)
  
  message("Combo, ", fld, " categories (q < ", SIG_CUTOFF, "): ", nrow(df_fld))
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("qvalue_combo_", fld, "_noMobilome.png")),
    qval_plots[[fld]], width = 10,
    height = max(2, 0.25 * nrow(df_fld) + 1),
    dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

qval_plots[["functional_category"]]
qval_plots[["protein_description"]]
```

```{r manhattan plots }

#path to the min bh values
all_rows_path <- "pre_end_summary_all_rows.tsv"

manhattan_out_dir <- "manhattan_plots"

# Exact protein_description string to highlight
TARGET_ANNOT <- "helix-turn-helix domain-containing protein"

SIG_LINE <- -log10(0.05) 


#load site-level q values, restrict to the 29 MAGs 
all_rows <- readr::read_tsv(all_rows_path, col_types = readr::cols())

df_q <- all_rows %>%
  filter(test %in% c("paired_tTest", "control_tTest", "fat_tTest")) %>%
  rename(MAG_ID = basename) %>%
  filter(MAG_ID %in% keep_mag_ids) %>%          # <-- 29-MAG filter
  mutate(
    q_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(q_value)),
    gene_id = na_if(gene_id, "nan")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(q_value), !is.na(gene_id))



#Collapse sites to one q per gene, per test 
#min q val across the gene
per_gene_q <- df_q %>%
  group_by(MAG_ID, gene_id, test) %>%
  summarise(q_gene = min(q_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


#Flag target annotation genes
# Straight from recognizer, so this does not depend on any enrichment objects.
#each gene can carry multiple COG hits, so collapse to one TRUE/FALSE per gene.
target_gene_ids <- recognizer %>%
  filter(protein_description == TARGET_ANNOT) %>%
  distinct(qseqid) %>%
  pull(qseqid)


per_gene_q <- per_gene_q %>%
  mutate(is_target = gene_id %in% target_gene_ids)


#Scaffold layout


gene_layout <- per_gene_q %>%
  distinct(MAG_ID, gene_id) %>%                     # <-- no `test` here
  mutate(
    scaffold    = str_replace(gene_id, "_[^_]+$", ""),
    gene_number = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(gene_id, "[^_]+$")))
  ) %>%
  group_by(MAG_ID, scaffold) %>%
  arrange(gene_number, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(gene_within_scaffold = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

cumulative_positions <- gene_layout %>%
  group_by(MAG_ID, scaffold) %>%
  summarise(scaffold_length = max(gene_within_scaffold), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(MAG_ID) %>%
  arrange(scaffold, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(offset = lag(cumsum(scaffold_length), default = 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

gene_layout <- gene_layout %>%
  left_join(cumulative_positions %>% select(MAG_ID, scaffold, offset),
            by = c("MAG_ID", "scaffold")) %>%
  mutate(cumulative_x = offset + gene_within_scaffold)

# Join the shared layout onto the per test q-values
plot_df <- per_gene_q %>%
  left_join(gene_layout, by = c("MAG_ID", "gene_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    q_safe     = pmax(q_gene, .Machine$double.xmin),
    neglog10_q = -log10(q_safe)
  )

boundaries <- gene_layout %>%
  group_by(MAG_ID, scaffold) %>%
  summarise(xend = max(cumulative_x), .groups = "drop")

md2 <- read.table("gtdbtk_representative_taxonomy.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

#plot the manhattan type plots
plot_manhattan <- function(df, genome_name, label_targets = TRUE) {
  gd <- df %>% filter(MAG_ID == genome_name)
  if (!nrow(gd)) {
    message("No data for ", genome_name)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  bnd <- boundaries %>% filter(MAG_ID == genome_name)
  ttl <- paste0(genome_name,
                if (nzchar(gd$tax_label[1])) paste0(" | ", gd$tax_label[1]) else "")
  
  p <- ggplot(gd, aes(x = cumulative_x, y = neglog10_q)) +
    geom_vline(data = bnd, aes(xintercept = xend),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "gray85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = SIG_LINE, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    # non-target genes first, so target points draw on top
    geom_point(data = filter(gd, !is_target),
               color = "gray55", size = 1.1, alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(data = filter(gd, is_target),
               color = "#EA2284", size = 2.2, alpha = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~ test, ncol = 1, strip.position = "right") +
    labs(title = ttl, x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10](italic(q)))) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text.y     = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.text.x      = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x     = element_blank(),
      plot.title       = element_text(size = 8)
    )
    if (label_targets && any(gd$is_target)) {
    p <- p + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = filter(gd, is_target),
      aes(label = gene_id),
      size = 2.2, min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.4,
      segment.size = 0.3, max.overlaps = 20
    )
  }
  p
}


sanitize <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)

manhattan_plots <- list()

for (g in intersect(keep_mag_ids, unique(plot_df$MAG_ID))) {
  p <- plot_manhattan(plot_df, g)
  manhattan_plots[[g]] <- p
  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(manhattan_out_dir, paste0("manhattan_", sanitize(g), ".pdf")),
         p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
}

message("Saved ", length(manhattan_plots), " plots to ", manhattan_out_dir)
```

```{r phylogeny + presence-absence grid}

library(ape)
library(phytools)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

tree_path <- "mouse_MAGs.contree"
fig_out   <- "tree_presence_absence_29mags.pdf"

#
USE_NO_MOBILOME <- TRUE


##load tree and prune
phy_full <- ape::read.tree(tree_path)


tips_keep <- intersect(keep_mag_ids, phy_full$tip.label)
phy <- ape::keep.tip(phy_full, tips_keep)

phy_rooted <- phytools::midpoint.root(phy)

phy_ultra <- ape::chronos(phy_rooted)
class(phy_ultra) <- "phylo"    # chronos() returns class c("chronos","phylo")

#add columns of the grid = significantly enriched protein descriptions
hg_src <- if (USE_NO_MOBILOME) hg_bh_combo_nom else hg_bh_combo

sig_prot_desc <- hg_src %>%
  filter(category_col == "protein_description", hypergeo_p_adj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(hypergeo_p_adj) %>%          # most significant first (leftmost column)
  pull(category)


#Presence/absence matrix 

combo_sig_genes <- gene_flags_combo %>%
  filter(has_sig_site) %>%
  pull(qseqid)

annot_for_grid <- annotations_universe
if (USE_NO_MOBILOME) {
  annot_for_grid <- annot_for_grid %>%
    filter(is.na(functional_category) |
             functional_category != "Mobilome: prophages, transposons")
}

pa_long <- annot_for_grid %>%
  filter(qseqid %in% combo_sig_genes,
         protein_description %in% sig_prot_desc,
         MAG_ID %in% tips_keep) %>%
  distinct(MAG_ID, protein_description) %>%
  mutate(present = "Present")
pa_grid <- expand.grid(
  MAG_ID              = tips_keep,
  protein_description = sig_prot_desc,
  stringsAsFactors    = FALSE
) %>%
  left_join(pa_long, by = c("MAG_ID", "protein_description")) %>%
  mutate(present = ifelse(is.na(present), "Absent", present))

pa_mat <- pa_grid %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = protein_description, values_from = present) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("MAG_ID")

# preserve significance ordering of columns
pa_mat <- pa_mat[, sig_prot_desc, drop = FALSE]



#phylum colors from md2

  phylum_df <- md2 %>%
    select(user_genome, classification) %>%
    filter(user_genome %in% tips_keep) %>%
    mutate(Phylum = stringr::str_match(classification, "p__([^;]*)")[, 2],
           Phylum = dplyr::na_if(Phylum, ""),
           Phylum = ifelse(is.na(Phylum), "Unassigned", Phylum)) %>%
    select(label = user_genome, Phylum)



#Plot
p_tree <- ggtree(phy_ultra, size = 0.6) %<+% phylum_df +
  aes(color = Phylum) +
  # internal branches have no phylum assignment -> draw them black
  scale_color_discrete(na.value = "black") +
  theme(legend.position = "left")

p_full <- gheatmap(
  p_tree,
  pa_mat,
  offset          = 0.02,
  width           = 1.6,
  colnames_angle  = -45,
  colnames_offset_y = -0.4,
  hjust           = 0,
  font.size       = 2.6,
  color           = "grey70"          # cell borders
) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Present = "grey45", Absent = "white"),
    name   = "Enriched protein\ndescription"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Species showing adaptive divergence of enriched protein descriptions") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 60, 5))

print(p_full)

ggsave(fig_out, p_full, width = 11,
       height = max(6, 0.28 * length(tips_keep) + 3), limitsize = FALSE)

message("Saved: ", fig_out)

```
